text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Agnes Tachyon displays a stellar run at
the
Satsuki Sho G1 race!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. These findings aren't bad at all.
Many
points are in line with the results
of the trial
experiment, and my
preparations have gone
along
swimmingly. My hard work has paid off.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
However... having experienced these
results
firsthand, I now see even further
latent potential.
With th—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's you, Trainer. I was just talking to
myself.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
More importantly, I ran in both the
Yayoi Sho and
Satsuki Sho races, true to
my word.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Which leaves me with just one more of
the
Classics...
choice_data_list: Next up is the Japan Derby!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Ha, you would beat me to it. That is the
next
logical step. Still...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
For this next occasion, I hope you'll
allow me to
take the helm. The odds for
Plan A aren't looking
too favorable.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that's... for me to know. You need
not worry
about it.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
The point is, I cannot promise that I'll
run in the
race. I hope I'm making myself
clear.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
For some reason, her assertion comes off
more
forceful than usual.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Good. Well, time is of the essence! With
all the
data I've just gathered from my
competitors, I
must make haste in
resuming my experiments!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: It is the time to put Plan B into action.
choice_data_list: (...Did she start some new research, I wonder?)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She walks off alone, leaving me to
wonder what
her real intentions might
be.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
For now, what I do know is that she's
serious
about running in the Japanese
Derby.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But in the end, it'll all be up to her.
